title: Undo and redo while bots play
description: A history change can lose a race against a bot decision. The server now holds bots back during the change; when the game still moves, the client retries with a fresh version and says so in plain words. The history buttons say why they are disabled while a change runs. Before: the raw text 'History change failed (409): History change conflicts with the game: ...' (the old client cannot be re-rendered from this branch, so there is no before picture).

shots.heading: The game moved on
shots.caption: After the retries run out the banner reads 'The game moved on while redoing — try again'.

shots.heading: Buttons wait for a running change
shots.caption: The redo buttons are disabled while the request runs; hovering shows why (title tooltip, drawn by the capture helper).
